summary: Real Messenger Corp filed a 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter for failing to maintain a $1 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days as of July 21, 2026. The company has 180 days, until January 19, 2027, to regain compliance by trading at $1 or above for 10 consecutive business days, or by effecting a reverse stock split before January 5, 2027. No specific price, premium, or deal terms are stated. The filing is a routine regulatory notification of listing standards non-compliance, not an active special situation event.
